old_caption: The video captures a serene scene in a clear, shallow body of water. Various aquatic plants with green leaves and stems are scattered throughout. Several fish, including dark blue and orange ones, swim among the plants. The camera moves slowly, revealing more of the underwater landscape. Sunlight filters through, casting dappled light on the plants and fish, enhancing the tranquil atmosphere. The overall ambiance is peaceful, with the natural beauty of the underwater environment being the focal point.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene underwater scene in a clear, shallow body of water. The water is filled with various aquatic plants, including green leaves and stems, which are scattered throughout the frame. Several fish, ranging in color from dark blue to orange, swim gracefully among the plants. The fish move fluidly, creating gentle ripples on the surface of the water. The camera pans slowly across the scene, revealing more of the underwater landscape. The sunlight filters through the water, casting a dappled light effect on the plants and fish, enhancing the tranquil atmosphere. The overall ambiance is peaceful, with the natural beauty of the underwater environment being the focal point.
caption: The video captures a shallow, clear pond seen from above, where thin green stems topped with yellow and pale leaves rise from a sandy bottom. Pale reflections of tree trunks and a standing figure stretch across the upper water surface. Two elongated purple fish hover near the center, gradually gliding to the right through the submerged stems. A pale fish and a dark fish rest near the upper right, while an orange-and-white fish drifts near the top center. The handheld viewpoint drifts slowly, sliding the plant clusters and reflections toward the right edge and revealing more floating leaves along the left. Light ripples shift subtly from frame to frame, occasionally blurring the scene. The fish keep moving at a slow, steady pace as the clip continues.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
